key.name: symbols
key.summary: Yahoo Finance symbols to follow
key.description: Use the exact Yahoo ticker, including the exchange suffix where one applies (VWCE.DE, EURUSD=X, BTC-EUR, ^GSPC).

key.name: panel-symbol
key.summary: Deprecated: single symbol shown in the top bar
key.description: Superseded by panel-symbols; migrated on first start and then cleared.

key.name: panel-symbols
key.summary: Symbols shown in the top bar
key.description: Empty means the first symbol in the list. Entries not present in symbols are ignored.

key.name: panel-separator
key.summary: Text drawn between symbols in the top bar
key.description: Empty means the symbols are separated by spacing alone.

key.name: holdings
key.summary: Position held in each symbol
key.description: Maps a symbol to "QUANTITY COST", both written with a dot as the decimal mark; the cost is per share and may be left off. A symbol with no entry here is followed but not held.

key.name: show-portfolio
key.summary: Show position values and a portfolio total in the popup
key.description: Only has an effect for symbols that carry a holding.

key.name: base-currency
key.summary: Currency the portfolio total is reported in
key.description: An ISO code such as EUR or USD. Holdings quoted in another currency are converted through Yahoo's own FX pairs. Empty means no conversion, so a total is only shown while every holding shares one currency.

key.name: benchmark
key.summary: Symbol overlaid on the details chart for comparison
key.description: A Yahoo ticker such as ^GSPC or ACWI, rebased to the plotted symbol's first bar. Empty means no overlay.

key.name: pause-when-idle
key.summary: Stop polling while the session is idle
key.description: Refreshes resume, immediately if the data has gone stale, as soon as the session is active again.

key.name: show-graph
key.summary: Draw a price history graph under every symbol in the popup

key.name: history-range
key.summary: Period covered by the history graph

key.name: graph-height
key.summary: Height of the history graph in pixels

key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: Seconds between quote refreshes

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the TopRates icon in the top bar

key.name: show-label
key.summary: Show the panel label

key.name: font-scale
key.summary: Panel label size as a percentage of the default font size

key.name: font-family
key.summary: Font family used by the panel label and the popup
key.description: A font family name such as Montserrat, Arial or Monospace. Empty means the system font.

key.name: font-weight
key.summary: Panel label font weight

key.name: show-change
key.summary: Show the daily change percentage in the panel

key.name: colorize
key.summary: Colour gains green and losses red

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Panel box: left, center or right

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Index within the chosen panel box
